description: Selected M1 HEVC padding repair evidence; AI-prepared audit of retained local records. Not a full conformance or release qualification.
source_identity_limit: Tests ran with the patch in the working tree before a81e456 was committed. Guard source_commit records the then-current base HEAD, not the dirty diff. Original repair commit is preserved; runtime source is unchanged by this evidence-only commit.
kernel_limit: Existing linux-aurora kernel was not modified or reloaded. Guard records module presence, not the identity of every loaded module patch. No boot or kernel qualification is claimed.

offline.new_test_cases: 12 combinations: AVD/generic x Annex-B/no-start-code x 0/1/35 padding bytes, each containing two slices and an escaped 00 00 03 ending
offline.negative_original_source: assertion sp[0].bit_size == output_size[0] * 8 fails; signal ABRT
offline.frame_check: Native-size hashing: resolution change and crop match; truncated input fails.
offline.shared_contexts: Shared contexts, software: four streams, 168 frames match independent decoders
offline.execution: Completed builds/tests used companion tools/bounded-build with one worker. An initial auto-parallel Meson build was stopped and rebuilt with -j1; it is not counted as a completed test run.

hardware.journal_boundary_limit: Earlier failed/preflight attempts are retained below. The final boundary follows those completed failures; it is not a claim of a fault-free whole boot.
hardware.live_client_arguments: moonlight stream <private-host> Desktop --video-codec HEVC --video-decoder hardware --display-mode windowed --performance-overlay
hardware.decode_command_limit: The retained decode log confirms HEVC via /dev/video0 [avd], NV12 2560x1600 and guard status ok; its full original FFmpeg argv was not retained in that log. No reconstructed argv is represented as historical measurement.
actual_driver_log_excerpt: libva-v4l2request: surface 0x04000000 was exported before its first decode; decoding into client-exported dma-bufs
hardware.visual_limit: The live result measures decoded/rendered frame rates and driver selection. Independent visual confirmation or rendered-pixel comparison was not recorded.
